events.title: Hope
events.description: OPENS SEPTEMBER 9 | A mysterious discovery is made on the outskirts of the remote harbor town. The residents find themselves in a desperate fight for survival against something they have never encountered before. From writer/director Na Hong-jin.

events.title: Dreams in Nightmares
events.description: OPENS SEPTEMBER 11 | After an abrupt layoff, Z embarks on a trip across the Midwestern United States in search of a friend who has seemingly disappeared off the grid, in Shatara Michelle Ford's film about three queer Black femmes.

events.title: American Doctor
events.description: OPENS SEPTEMBER 11 | When three American doctors - one with Palestinian heritage, one Jewish, and one Parsi - enter Gaza to save lives, they find themselves caught between medicine and politics, risking everything to expose the truth.

events.title: It Ends
events.description: OPENS SEPTEMBER 4 | Out for a late-night drive, friends turn onto a never-ending, two-lane hellscape surrounded by untold horrors and cosmic forces beyond their understanding. Crammed inside a jeep with miles stretching infinitely ahead, they face a choice: embrace their new existence or fight to escape it. Winner of the Audience Award for Best Feature Film at the 2025 Anomaly Film Festival.

events.title: Filipiñana
events.description: OPENS SEPTEMBER 4 | Seventeen-year-old Isabel’s job — at an exclusive country club in her native Philippines — turns dark as she uncovers violence beneath the club's facade and discovers a disturbing connection from the past.

events.title: Coyote vs. Acme
events.description: OPENS AUGUST 28 | After enduring years of catastrophic product failures at the hands of ACME, Inc., a tenacious, unemployed coyote uncovers a corporate cover-up and spearheads an unhinged battle against the multinational conglomerate that’s been blowing him up in the name of profit. Also, there’s a roadrunner. And dynamite.
